Fix the llms.txt implementation for the US Flooring & Molding Inc. website.

CURRENT ERROR

The URL:

https://www.usflooring.la/llms.txt

currently returns the website’s homepage HTML and has:

Content-Type: text/html

This means the SPA fallback is incorrectly handling the llms.txt request. AI crawlers cannot read it as a proper llms.txt file.

REQUIRED IMPLEMENTATION

1. Create a real static file named exactly:

llms.txt

2. Place it in the project’s public/static root directory so it is deployed at:

https://www.usflooring.la/llms.txt

For a Vite or React project, the expected location is normally:

/public/llms.txt

3. Do not create llms.txt as a React page, component, or client-side route.

4. Ensure that requests to /llms.txt are served before the SPA catch-all or index.html fallback.

5. The deployed response must meet all these requirements:

- HTTP status: 200
- Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8
- No HTML
- No JavaScript
- No redirect
- No canonical tag
- No noindex directive
- The first line of the response must be:
  # US Flooring & Molding Inc.

6. Do not change the website’s existing design, navigation, pages, SEO metadata, sitemap, robots.txt, or functionality.

USE THIS EXACT CONTENT FOR llms.txt:
